method: Each of the 442 THRESHOLD_CANDIDATE literals classified by reading its live_v4.py line + neighbors through ordered rules (NON_DECISION mechanics -> AUTHORIZED par/five/staircase -> SUPERSEDED entry-pricing keywords -> residual KEEP+ORPHAN). Reason recorded per row; automated first-pass, operator-auditable via the reason column.

proposed_owners.completion_reprice: SUPERSEDED_BY_PRICER (PROPOSED): completion repricing is the L9 completion layer the pricer owns; live completion_* becomes shadow post-cutover.
proposed_owners.completion_live_enabled: SUPERSEDED_BY_PRICER (PROPOSED): completion decision moves to the pricer completion layer.
proposed_owners.completion_combined_ceiling: KEEP+AUTHORIZED (PROPOSED): combined ceiling is par-law economics (100), retained as an execution guard.
proposed_owners.completion_cells_path: BOOT_GATE (PROPOSED): loader path; keep as a boot gate but its table is superseded by the pricer completion surface.
proposed_owners.complete_cross_enabled: KEEP (PROPOSED): emergency cross is execution safety, not pricing.
proposed_owners.window_truth_live: SUPERSEDED_BY_PRICER (PROPOSED): window-truth reaim is an entry-aim organ replaced by the pricer floor/verdict.
